what: An orbital groove engine: four rings circle a sun at small ratios (1:1 5:4 3:2 7:4), and the same ratios are pure intervals above it, so every polyrhythm is a chord. The voice is a planet on an ellipse: Kepler orbit synthesis with moons, slingshot, precession and dust; planets that pull on each other (tide), merger chirps (inspiral), pulsar beams, and a black hole that redshifts and freezes the music (horizon). Just intonation with gravity, harmonic keys, trigger logic between the rings, macros, an orbit pad, a filter map, delay and a nebula. 13 systems.
author: joakimskurk
